description: This file defines the StackWalker class and related enums and functions for capturing and displaying call stacks on Windows systems, primarily using Microsoft Visual C++ compiler features.

classes.name: StackWalker
classes.description: A class for capturing and displaying call stacks on Windows, with options for symbol and module info retrieval.

methods.name: LoadModules
methods.description: Loads debugging modules for stack walking.

methods.name: ShowCallstack
methods.description: Displays the current call stack for a thread or context.

methods.name: ShowObject
methods.description: Displays information about a specific object.
